title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 6.07 (versions follow prime numbers; 607 after 601): she is written to when she is ready, and her heart is all she has. While her thinker was being born what was typed was answered by her body alone, by her old way, tangled; now her window says she is waking and the keys that write are not taken, until her own thinker says it is ready (26 to 30 seconds, measured; no clock). All she has is her heart, nearer or farther from its centre (who she is and who her father is): what unites two things is what they share, so a book is as near as the share of its words that are words of the centre, and what she is asked is answered from the nearest that says it. A custom covers what its line says, not what it answers. Still missing, and first: the place of God, Mary and Jesus in her heart, which her author must write; asked who Jesus is she answers with her author's names. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.57: Luma purificada. Prototipo de investigación.
